findings.standard: An Instar Agent Is Always a Multi-Machine Entity
findings.reason: An older installed peer can retain the chat while losing its origin, yet the spec allows creation to succeed without requiring an all-member receipt or exposing the origin as Pending, so losing the creator can leave a surviving machine unable to recover the placement evidence.

The projection prefers indexed context and consults the companion only on absence, while boot reconciliation repairs missing companions, so neither path checks on a cadence that two present copies agree on the context itself.

Even with the rich graph disabled and an empty Chief cache, a legitimate first list request after restart can trigger cycle analysis over every resolved record before pagination, so a finite inventory alone does not justify treating whole-inventory request-time work as safe under the host’s resource floor.

findings.standard: Attributed Statements Trace to Their Source
findings.reason: The testing section calls queue routing the operator’s explicit instruction but quotes a Chief of Staff handoff, leaving the attribution to the operator without a pointer to the operator’s own logged words.
